summary: The source limits the number of bags to eight and k to at most that count, so even the unpruned assignment tree has at most 8^8 leaves. This fixed domain is too narrow for an honest asymptotic scaling verdict.

replacement_checks.evidence: Each of at most eight indivisible bags has at most eight child choices, so exhaustive assignment has no more than 8^8 leaves; symmetry and incumbent-bound pruning only reduce that work.
Regression compares the optimized reference with exhaustive labeled-child assignment across deterministic randomized small instances and verifies maximum-length, k=2, and k=n boundaries.
